title: Analista de Mídias Pagas Sr.
description:
Empresa está contratando Analista de Mídias Pagas Sr. em são leopoldo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Atendemos mais de 15 mil clientes  em todo o país e somos líderes em software de gestão na nuvem  para o setor gastronômico! Além disso, somos uma das Super Integradoras do iFood , entregando uma solução completa — do Ponto de Venda à Retaguarda. Incrível, né?  E tem mais: o iFood é nosso investidor!   Isso significa que estamos em crescimento exponencial e acelerado — por isso, queremos pessoas que compartilhem da nossa energia, da nossa vontade de inovar e de revolucionar o mercado de food service, para crescer junto com a gente!  🧡  Responsabilidades e atribuições  Buscamos uma pessoa Analista Sênior de Mídias Pagas  para ser responsável pela estratégia, execução e otimização das campanhas de aquisição paga, garantindo geração consistente de leads qualificados (HRs trabalháveis) , controle de custos e maximização de CPL e ROAS . Essa posição tem papel‑chave na sustentação do funil comercial e no crescimento da empresa.  O que vai fazer parte do seu dia a dia     Planejar, executar e otimizar campanhas demídia paga  em plataformas como Google Ads e Facebook Ads ;  Monitorar continuamente o desempenho das campanhas, ajustando estratégias para maximizar resultados, com foco em CPL, ROAS e geração de HRs trabalháveis ;  Analisar métricas de performance das campanhas, garantindo o atingimento das metas e KPIs estabelecidos;  Elaborar relatórios recorrentes de performance , identificando oportunidades de otimização e apresentando análises e resultados para a equipe e stakeholders;  Trabalhar em parceria com os times de Marketing e Vendas  para otimizar o funil de conversão, assegurando que o tráfego gerado se converta em leads qualificados e posteriormente em vendas;  Controlar, distribuir e otimizar oorçamento de mídia paga , garantindo o melhor retorno sobre o investimento (ROAS);  Implementar e gerenciar testes A/B  em campanhas, criativos e landing pages, buscando melhoria contínua de performance;  Explorar novos canais e oportunidades de mídia paga  para ampliar alcance e eficiência das campanhas;  Garantir o fluxo correto de leads e informações entre os sistemas , assegurando integração entre plataformas de mídia, CRM e ferramentas de marketing.    Requisitos e qualificações  O que esperamos de você      Experiência prévia comgerenciamento de campanhas em Google Ads e Facebook Ads ;  Experiência emanálise de dados de performance  ou funções correlatas;  Familiaridade comferramentas de análise de dados e CRM ;  Perfil analítico, commentalidade orientada a resultados  e forte capacidade de resolução de problemas;  Formação superior emMarketing, Administração ou áreas correlatas ;  Excel intermediário , com capacidade de análise e organização de dados.    O que vai te destacar por aqui     Experiência prévia naconstrução ou participação em programas de indicação ;  Vivência em દેશ***saas ;  Conhecimento avançado emExcel  eHubSpot ;  Experiência comprovada comogestor(a) de projetos ;  Participação em projetos comganhos financeiros comprovados ;  Certificações emgestão de projetos . title: Designer Gráfico e Digital (Foco em IA e Inovação Visual)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Designer Gráfico e Digital (Foco em IA e Inovação Visual) em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Designer Gráfico e Digital (Foco em IA e Inovação Visual) O Grupo Weducation  e a Foreducation EdTech  buscam um Designer apaixonado por educação e tecnologia. Procuramos alguém que domine as ferramentas tradicionais (Adobe/Figma), mas que já tenha integrado fluxos de trabalho com Inteligência Artificial para elevar a qualidade e a velocidade de nossas entregas online e offline. Desafios da Função  Você será responsável por transformar briefings em experiências visuais memoráveis, atuando desde a concepção de campanhas até a finalização de vídeos animados. Sua missão é unir o rigor técnico do design gráfico com o potencial criativo da IA Generativa. O que buscamos (Requisitos)  Formação e Experiência:  Graduação completa  em Design Gráfico, Design Digital, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas. Domínio avançado do Pacote Adobe  (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere e After Effects). Conhecimento de Figma , com noções de UI/UX  para projetos digitais. Desejável domínio de Corel Draw  (para suportar materiais legados ou específicos de impressão - é raro, mas pode acontecer rs). Inglês Intermediário:  Essencial para consumo de tutoriais e interface com ferramentas de IA de última geração. Experiência (ou forte interesse) na integração de IA Generativa  no fluxo de design (ex: Midjourney para assets, Firefly para edição rápida, HeyGen/Runway para animações ou ChatGPT para auxílio criativo).  Responsabilidades Principais  Criação Multimeios:  Desenvolver peças gráficas para comunicação online (redes sociais, banners, e-mails) e offline (materiais didáticos, sinalização, eventos). Conceito Criativo:  Participar ativamente de brainstormings com o time de marketing para criar conceitos de campanhas e anúncios. Produção de Vídeo:  Edição de vídeos dinâmicos e criação de pequenas animações (Motion Graphics) para redes sociais e treinamentos. Gestão de Fluxo:  Gerenciar briefings e prazos através de metodologias organizadas, garantindo a entrega pontual e de alta qualidade. Tratamento e Curadoria:  Garantir o tratamento profissional de imagens e a unidade visual entre os materiais das marcas do grupo.  Habilidades Valorizadas  Escrita criativa e excelente comunicação interpessoal. Pensamento crítico para julgar a qualidade técnica do que é gerado por IA. Capacidade de solucionar problemas de forma ágil e autônoma.  O que oferecemos  Remuneração:  R$ 5.000,00. Benefícios:  Vale Alimentação, Seguro de Vida Empresarial e Vale Transporte. Diferencial Exclusivo: Possibilidade de bolsa de estudos para filhos em escolas associadas ao grupo. Localização:  Colégio Mater Dei (Jardim Paulista, São Paulo).  Gostou do desafio?  Para se candidatar, envie seu portfólio (queremos ver tanto seus projetos de design "puro" quanto experimentos ou peças onde a tecnologia foi sua aliada). Sobre as Empresas  Grupo Weducation:  O Grupo Weducation é um ecossistema educacional de referência que foca na gestão e transformação de instituições de ensino. Nosso compromisso é elevar o padrão da educação básica, unindo tradição acadêmica, inovação tecnológica e uma gestão eficiente para preparar alunos para os desafios do futuro. Foreducation EdTech:  A Foreducation é a braço tecnológico do grupo, sendo a primeira Google for Education Partner  do Brasil. Atuamos na vanguarda da transformação digital em escolas e universidades, implementando tecnologias que potencializam o aprendizado e capacitando educadores para o uso estratégico de ferramentas digitais e Inteligência Artificial. Onde você estará alocado: O CSC Esta vaga faz parte do nosso CSC (Centro de Serviços Compartilhados) . O CSC é o coração operacional e estratégico que atende a todas as unidades e marcas do grupo. Trabalhar aqui significa estar em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e com uma visão macro de todo o negócio, garantindo que a comunicação visual seja unificada e de excelência para todos os nossos públicos.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Cloud Infrastructure Engineer em blumenau. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Reports To:  IT Manager  Department  :  Information technologyLocation  : Blumenau, Brazil - Hybrid  At MTech Systems, our company mission is to increase yield in protein production to help feed the growing world population without compromising animal welfare or damaging the planet. We aim to create software that delivers real-time data to the entire supply chain that allows producers to get better insight into what is happening on their farms and what they can do to responsibly improve production.  MTech Systems is a prominent provider of tools for managing performance in Live Animal Protein Production. For over 30 years, MTech Systems has provided cutting‑edge enterprise data solutions for all aspects of the live poultry operations cycle. We provide our customers with solutions in Business Intelligence, Live Production Accounting, Production Planning, and Remote Data Management—all through an integrated system. Our applications can currently be found running businesses on six continents in over 50 countries. MTech has built an international reputation for equipping our customers with the power to utilize comprehensive data to maximize profitability.  With over 250 employees globally, MTech Systems currently has main offices in Mexico, United States, and Brazil, with additional resources in key markets around the world. MTech Systems USA’s headquarters is based in Atlanta, Georgia and has approximately 90 team members in a casual, collaborative environment. Our work culture here is based on a commitment to helping our clients feed the world, resulting in a flexible and rewarding atmosphere. We are committed to maintaining a work culture that enhances collaboration, provides robust development tools, offers training programs, and allows for direct access to senior and executive management.  Job Summary  We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong customer‑facing experience to join our IT team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of cloud architecture, automation, and customer success. You’ll work closely with internal teams and external customers to design, deploy, and support scalable, secure, and cost‑effective cloud infrastructure—primarily in Microsoft Azure.  You’ll play a key role in modernizing our infrastructure, supporting SaaS deployments, and ensuring our customers have a seamless experience with our cloud‑hosted solutions. This is a hands‑on engineering role with a strong emphasis on communication, collaboration, and continuous improvement.  Responsibilities  Key Responsibilities   Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure to support customer‑facing applications.  Collaborate with product, development, and customer success teams to ensure infrastructure meets customer needs and SLAs.  Lead cloud onboarding and deployment efforts for new customers, including infrastructure provisioning, networking, and security configuration.  Optimize cloud costs and performance through proactive analysis and automation.  Serve as a technical advisor to customers and internal stakeholders on cloud best practices, security, and architecture.  Document infrastructure designs, runbooks, and customer‑specific configurations.  Provide Tier 3 support for cloud‑related issues and participate in incident response and root cause analysis.  Stay current with emerging cloud technologies and recommend improvements to our cloud strategy.    Minimum Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.  5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering or systems administration, with at least 2 years in a customer‑facing or consulting role.  Proficient in Microsoft Azure, including Azure AD, networking, storage, and compute services.  Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.  Excellent communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.    Preferred Qualifications   Experience with hybrid cloud environments and legacy system integration.  Familiarity with customer onboarding, technical account management, or solution architecture.  Knowledge of security frameworks and compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001).    EEO Statement  Integrated into our shared values is MTech’s commitment to diversity and equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. MTech aims to maintain a global inclusive workplace where every person is regarded fairly, appreciated for their uniqueness, advanced according to their accomplishments, and encouraged to fulfill their highest potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at MTech has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.  Compensation  Negotible  Posted:  Monday, January 12, 2026Job #  191   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Ex.: PMP (Project Management Professional) ou Agile;  Atuação comprovada em Metodologia Ágil (Scrum), Squad e/ou Mesa de Performance;  Atuação em projetos envolvendo aplicativos.  Equipe multidisciplinar e colaborativa.  Ambiente propício ao crescimento.  Flexibilidade de jornada.  Oportunidade de fazer a diferença e impactar diretamente o crescimento do negócio. title: Research Associate
description:

Join to apply for the Research Associate  role at Gi Group Holding .  Overview  Responsible for managing recruitment and selection services, supporting consultants in achieving their goals within Wyser’s Technology team in São Paulo. This role involves participating in processes across Brazil for both national and international clients.  As a Life Changer, you will:   Support the entire recruitment and selection process through research, analysis, pre‑screening, interviews, and recommendations, always aiming for excellence.  Make strategic decisions regarding recruitment approaches and outreach channels for each project, working in partnership with consultants to achieve the best results.  Assist consultants in sourcing candidates to be introduced into the recruitment process for later client presentation.  Prepare, edit, and publish job openings on LinkedIn and other channels for candidate applications.  Source profiles (active and passive candidates), identify interview lists, and initiate first contact via phone before validating with the consultant prior to client presentation.  Present candidate lists for consultant or client evaluation.  Collect references (for both commercial and selection purposes) when required.  Support consultants in scheduling interviews with candidates and clients throughout the selection process.  Provide feedback to candidates and, when necessary, to clients to align expectations regarding process outcomes.  Produce market candidate mapping reports based on client needs using the Hunting methodology.  Assess candidates using “Assessment Center” tools and methodologies to validate behavioral profiles.  Deliver “Employer Branding Campaigns” (Brand Awareness and Sourcing) using Wyser’s tools and methodologies in partnership with the Marketing department to strengthen brand presence among candidates and clients.  If needed, deliver the “Global Talents” program for international mobility in partnership with other countries.  Develop a network with candidates to strengthen strategic commercial relationships.  Maintain long‑term relationships with stakeholders (clients and candidates) to foster loyalty.  List potential clients for consultant outreach and source candidate resumes from alternative platforms.  Present the most promising candidates to consultants for review, ensuring greater assertiveness.  Support consultants in weekly outreach of key profiles to potential clients to align expectations.  Track and monitor delivery KPIs using company reporting tools to validate metrics and goals.  Update client and candidate information in CRM and ATS tracking systems to keep internal databases current.    What You Need to Be a Life Changer   Advanced Excel required; Power BI is a plus.  Experience with ATS platforms and AI tools.  Advanced English proficiency.  Ability to design search fields and strategic funneling.  Experience in executive market hunting and mapping is a plus.  Variable Compensation Program based on individual and team goals.  Meal and grocery vouchers.  Medical (no cost for primary holder) and dental insurance.  Wellhub by Gympass for health and wellness.  Private pension plan to help you plan for the future.  Pluxee Cuida: 24/7 access to psychological guidance, legal assistance, financial education, and social support.  Life insurance.  Birthday month day off.  Fuel allowance.  Vehicle insurance.    Benefits  We value leaders who seek continuous growth. That’s why we offer the Leadership Academy , in partnership with USP ESALQ, with development tracks for different management levels, covering topics such as humanized leadership, emotional intelligence, and time management.  Our performance management is supported by the Qulture.Rocks  platform, integrating goals, feedback, IDPs, and performance evaluations in a digital and collaborative environment.  We use the 9Box methodology  to map talents and successors, combining performance and competencies to identify readiness and potential. This process starts at strategic levels (N1 and N2) and is expanding to N4, strengthening our succession and development culture.  Culture & Inclusion  We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, welcoming all individuals regardless of their differences. We are committed to creating a space where everyone can thrive and contribute their best. We recognize the importance of including and supporting people with disabilities and work to ensure all opportunities are accessible, fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment. Integração Técnica: Noções de visualização em GitHub/GitLab e pipelines de CI/CD.  Comunicação: Uso fluente de Slack, Discord e Google Meet. Conhecimento aprofundado dos processos de Engenharia de Software.  Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou Analista de Negócios em empresas de plataforma SaaS.    Competências   Comunicação Assertiva: Capacidade de comunicação clara e objetiva, tanto verbal quanto escrita, facilitando o entendimento entre áreas distintas.  Organização: Excelência na organização e gestão de prioridades em um ambiente dinâmico.  Negociação: Habilidade para negociar prazos e escopos com stakeholders e time técnico. Your role goes beyond delivering measurable business outcomes—you will be a proactive partner in client success, maintaining clear and transparent communication about performance, strategy adjustments, and key optimizations. This ongoing engagement builds trust, strengthens client relationships, and positions CTC as a strategic leader in performance marketing.  As a Senior Media Buyer, you set a high standard, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and a results‑focused approach. You thrive in fast‑paced environments, take ownership of performance outcomes, and are committed to continuous learning and innovation. We embrace the mantra, "Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me," meaning we take responsibility, execute with excellence, and see strategies through to success.  Key Responsibilities   Develop and lead the implementation of accurate, insight‑driven forecasts using the Prophet system and Statlas.  Partner with clients to maintain clear, transparent communication about performance, strategy adjustments, and key optimizations.  Execute the full media buying lifecycle from strategy to creative to budgeting and optimization.  Implement and uphold CTC’s Meta best practices, build campaigns using our structure, and manage ongoing testing to improve performance.  Maintain data integrity for all clients across Statlas and ensure campaign reporting aligns with client goals.  Achieve a daily alignment within 5% delta of forecasted performance and ensure all work is delivered on time and to high quality.  Collaborate with the Brain Trust for ideas, contributing best practices and new ideas across teams.  Regularly update clients with performance reports, maintain alignment on strategy, and provide weekly updates on the Weekly Strategy Call.  Contribute learnings back to the system for continuous improvement, and support future company content production.  Lead the implementation of emergent practices and serve as an early adopter for new tools.    Core Values & Expectations   Autodidact:   Natural curiosity and an autodidact mindset, absorbing information rapidly.  Openness to offer and embrace feedback as an opportunity for growth, implementing it proactively.  Demonstrated resourcefulness, refining skills independently.  Thrives in a self‑managed environment, showing autonomy, initiative, and continuous improvement without needing constant oversight.      Unimpeachable Character:   Embodies a character that inspires pride in personal and professional associations.  Consistently honest, with the courage to acknowledge and communicate hard truths, and the humility to accept them even when uncomfortable.  Displays a high level of self‑awareness, taking full ownership of outcomes without resorting to a victim mindset.  Values constructive feedback and integrates it, understanding that nothing great is built without feedback.      Competitive Greatness:   Performs at their best when it matters most, enjoying hard challenges.  Demonstrates an unyielding determination to get things done, regardless of obstacles, time constraints, or resources.  Adapts to changing circumstances, exceeding what is required.  Possesses a deep passion for work, using creativity and resilience to overcome hurdles.        Onboarding & Kick‑Off   Be willing to put in the hard work required and be hungry enough for the kick‑off.  Prepare for this to be the hardest job you have ever worked; you will fundamentally develop a high‑leverage new skill.  Implement feedback rapidly.  Deliver work to the fullest with quality and on time.  Show perseverance.  Learn from repetitive exercises.    Client Communication & Quality Standards   Champion clear communication with clients, aligning on Growth Map goals and next steps.  Send daily performance updates to the client.  Ensure daily alignment across strategy and forecast with the client.  Provide weekly updates on the Weekly Strategy Call.  Maintain a 5% delta to the forecast.  Ensure daily alignment with the client versus forecast and strategy.  Achieve above‑benchmark client satisfaction.  Follow the Prophet system execution to 100% within required timelines.  Deliver all work on time with optimal quality and attention to detail.    Next‑Level Skills   Communication Skills:   Fluent in English, persuasively communicating and presenting ideas to stakeholders.  Skilled in crafting thoughtful, empathetic client messaging.  Strong presentation skills, driving engagement and decisionmaking.      Great Data Analysis Skills:   Strong raw talent for data analysis, eager to learn and improve.  Familiarity with data tools, including Google Sheets, and able to develop advanced skills on the job.      Past Experience:   Broad experience from domains such as mathematics, data analytics, business operations, retail, finance, media buying, etc.      Critical Thinking:   Approaches challenges with structured thinking and logical frameworks.  Dissects issues and proposes practical, impactful solutions.      Impact:   Passionate about e‑commerce, eager to contribute to a high‑performing team.  Highly motivated and hardworking, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.  Thrives where they can see direct results of their actions, preferring roles with full accountability and autonomy.        Results & Goals   Achieve certification and confidence in our ideology by the end of kick‑off to enable precise execution of the Prophet system.  Consistently deliver high‑accuracy performance within 5% delta across the Growth Map and Statlas.  Lead and collaborate with the team to optimize productivity and maintain high‑performance standards.  Apply best practices in media buying to drive outstanding results.  Maintain client satisfaction above benchmark rates.  Adhere to rigorous quality standards in client feedback, forecasting, and system execution.  Meet all deadlines and budget requirements, ensuring timely performance.  Contribute valuable ideas to team discussions and company‑wide content.    Domain & Management   Supervisor: Joy Sharma, Director of the CTC Accelerator Program.  Reporting directly to Joy, a mentor known for relentless pursuit of excellence and immense passion for growth strategy.    Orientation & What’s in It for Me?   This role will be client‑facing.  Salary Range:      First month: $2,000  Second month: $4,000  Third month (on average): $7,000 a month  1st Year Annual Range: $64,000–$76,000  2nd Year Annual Range: $100,000–$120,000      Growth, Transparency, and Fairness in Career Development.      Progress is clearly defined based on experience and quality of execution.  Fairness and transparency are prioritized with a weekly performance dashboard.  Pay transparency upheld with a clear roadmap for increasing earnings.      Location & Environment:      Fully remote with ability to pick your schedule.  Embrace autonomy as a core value, with clear expectations and regular 1:1 feedback sessions.  Exceptional work is recognized and rewarded with weekly check‑ins for accountability. title: Líder da Equipe de Mudança Climática (Remote)
description:
Confira a vaga para Líder da Equipe de Mudança Climática (Remote) em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

O Projeto Hospitais Saudáveis (PHS) está buscando um profissional dinâmico, motivado e criativo para a posição de Líder da Equipe de Clima. Este profissional terá a missão de ampliar o envolvimento do setor de saúde brasileiro com o enfrentamento da crise climática, como parte de uma campanha global para alinhar as organizações de saúde à ambição do Acordo de Paris e mobilizar o setor para a ação climática. O Líder da Equipe de Clima trabalhará em estreita colaboração com o Presidente do Conselho, funcionários e membros, para fortalecer a base de membros do PHS e para desenvolver novas etapas do trabalho climático do PHS. O trabalho inclui ampliar o engajamento dos sistemas de saúde com a redução das suas pegadas climáticas e também para que os governos nacional e subnacionais incluam a saúde nas políticas climáticas e o clima nas políticas de saúde.  Sobre o PHS  O PHS é uma organização formada por profissionais de saúde e meio ambiente que se dedica a promover a responsabilidade e a gestão ambiental nas organizações de saúde brasileiras, bem como seu engajamento em defesa da saúde ambiental. Desde o início das suas atividades, há mais de doze anos, o PHS tem sido parceiro no Brasil da organização internacional Health Care Without Harm, uma ONG dedicada à mobilização do setor de saúde para a saúde e a justiça ambiental. Durante esse período o PHS mobilizou uma rede que inclui 221 unidades de saúde (hospitais e unidades ambulatoriais e de apoio) e doze sistemas de saúde que representam mais de 320 hospitais adicionais, atuando em todas as regiões do país. Como resultado dessa articulação, dezenas de organizações membros passaram a medir suas emissões de GEE e tomar medidas para reduzi-las. O PHS também organiza uma conferência anual sobre sustentabilidade na assistência à saúde, com forte conteúdo climático. Nos últimos doze anos, esta conferência teve mais de 8.000 participantes.  O PHS está em um momento único, com sólida trajetória e novas oportunidades para financiar seu crescimento. O PHS busca um profissional com experiência em clima e em saúde, para liderar uma pequena equipe e trabalhar em conjunto à rede internacional da HCWH que desempenha um papel de liderança na definição da agenda de clima e saúde globalmente.  O objetivo do PHS é alinhar a assistência à saúde no Brasil, cuja cadeia produtiva é responsável por 4,5% das emissões nacionais líquidas, com a ambição do Acordo de Paris e mobilizar o setor para a defesa de ações climáticas mais amplas. Para isso, o PHS trabalha em três frentes: mitigação, resiliência e liderança. Nos próximos quatro anos, o PHS planeja expandir três vezes o número de hospitais engajados em ações climáticas, reduzindo a demanda de energia por meio de maior eficiência energética, principalmente em climatização, implementando a geração local de energia renovável e adotando uma série de outras medidas de mitigação. No nível político, o PHS planeja ampliar a colaboração com governos estaduais promovendo políticas e planos de ação para descarbonizar e mobilizar o setor de saúde para cobrar dos governos alternativas aos combustíveis fósseis e ampliação do uso de energia renovável como contribuição ao movimento mais amplo de energia limpa no Brasil.  Sobre as atribuições  O PHS procura um líder com conhecimento em gestão e sólida experiência em gerenciamento de equipes e em políticas e advocacy junto aos governos nacional e subnacionais do Brasil para questões de clima e saúde. O candidato ideal deve ter habilidade para trabalhar com o setor de saúde e conhecimento em mudanças climáticas e/ou saúde ambiental. O líder da equipe de clima se reportará ao presidente do PHS e trabalhará em colaboração com a equipe internacional da HCWH, como parceiro da rede global da HCWH.  Descrição da vaga  Liderança e gestão   Gerenciar equipe pequena e dinâmica atuando no Brasil em nível nacional.  Liderar o trabalho da equipe no apoio e engajamento dos os membros, buscando novos membros e incrementando a sua participação nos desafios climático, energético, de compras e de resíduos.  Juntamente com o Presidente do Conselho e com o Conselho, desenvolver estratégias e planos de trabalho anuais da PHS.  Trabalhar lado a lado com o Presidente do Conselho na elaboração de estratégias e táticas para o crescimento do PHS.  Se envolver e articular com a equipe da HCWH Internacional, mantendo estreita comunicação e alinhamento estratégico com as equipes globais e regionais da HCWH, além de atuar junto à equipe climática global da HCWH.  Liderar a implementação da estratégia climática do PHS, o crescimento e o desenvolvimento do Health Care Climate Challenge, o desenvolvimento do desafio energético e a conexão programática com o programa de compras, GGHH e outros projetos globais.  Monitorar e acompanhar o alinhamento da estratégia de PHS com a estratégia climática global de HCWH.  Gerenciar planos e orçamentos do PHS e supervisionar sua implementação bem-sucedida, garantindo o uso eficaz dos recursos e a submissão de relatórios aos doadores.  Supervisionar o assistente administrativo e apoiar a gestão administrativa e financeira e auditorias, sob a supervisão do tesoureiro e do presidente do conselho.    Engajamento de políticas: liderar os esforços da PHS para o desenvolvimento integrar os cuidados de saúde na política climática e o clima na política de saúde no Brasil   Participar do desenvolvimento colaborativo com a HCWH, de uma estrutura de ação política comum, com base na experiência existente e nos objetivos organizacionais que podem ser usados para ganhar escala em vários estados do Brasil.  Envolver redes de governos subnacionais, redes de saúde e redes climáticas no Brasil para ampliar colaborativamente a ação climática dos serviços de saúde. Quando relevante, trabalhar em colaboração com a OMS, o PNUD e outras agências internacionais.  Trabalhar para mobilizar contribuições do setor saúde às Contribuições Nacionalmente Determinadas do Brasil para o Acordo de Paris.  Liderar o desenvolvimento de plano de ação nacional que alinhe os sistemas de saúde com a ambição do Acordo de Paris, incluindo a obtenção de zero emissões até 2050.    Associação e Coordenação  Garantir um forte relacionamento com os membros e promover sua participação ativa no PHS, principalmente no tema da Mudança Climática, através de:   Manter a conscientização dos membros sobre as atividades, conquistas e progresso nos Desafios por meio de uma comunicação estreita e contínua.  Fornecer liderança inspiradora por meio da cooperação e parceria com os membros.  Fortalecer o perfil internacional do PHS, identificando oportunidades de engajamento e garantindo que iniciativas que se destaquem sejam aproveitados em todas as representações internacionais.  Apoiar o desenvolvimento da estratégia de associação do PHS, catalisar, influenciar e mobilizar o apoio à ação colaborativa.  Fornecer assistência técnica aos membros nos inventários de GEE e outras ferramentas técnicas.    Representação  • Representar o PHS junto aos parceiros, stakeholders, instituições públicas e financiadores, quando necessário. • Iniciar e apoiar o desenvolvimento de alianças estratégicas com as partes interessadas que trabalham em Clima e Saúde.  Habilidades e Experiência   Sólida experiência em gerenciamento, pelo menos 3 anos de experiência liderando equipes pequenas e dinâmicas.  Especialização em Mudanças Climáticas e/ou saúde ambiental.  Sólida compreensão das questões climáticas: debates atuais, estratégias de mitigação, CNDs e iniciativas em nível local e nacional no Brasil.  Conhecimento das metodologias de cálculo e inventários de emissões de Gases de Efeito Estufa.  Conhecimento da interseção entre clima e saúde.  Experiência de trabalho com ou no setor de saúde.  Capacidade comprovada em envolver equipes na tomada de decisão participativa, resolução criativa de problemas e capacidade de motivar equipes.  Capacidade de se comunicar e negociar com as principais partes interessadas internas e externas.  Compreensão do planejamento e execução do orçamento.  Experiência na organização de eventos e conferências públicas.  Fluência em português e inglês. Conhecimento de espanhol seria uma vantagem.  Capacidade de buscar e fornecer feedback de forma proativa e forte inteligência emocional.  Capacidade de trabalhar de forma eficaz e cooperativa com outras pessoas e alcançar objetivos compartilhados em uma equipe descentralizada.  Capacidade de priorizar e gerenciar vários projetos simultaneamente e acompanhar os problemas em tempo hábil.    Localização   Remota (home office).  O candidato precisa estar localizado em São Paulo ou no Rio de Janeiro; outros locais próximos a SP podem ser considerados. De tempos em tempos, o candidato deve trabalhar fora do horário comercial para participar de chamadas internacionais. O candidato deve poder viajar nacional e internacionalmente.    Remuneração   Remuneração competitiva e possibilidade de crescimento profissional.    PRAZO DE INSCRIÇÃO   15 de Março de 2020 - os candidatos serão pré-selecionados em base contínua, recomenda-se cadastrar-se o mais rápido possível.    Acesse o site, cadastre seu CV em português e anexe uma carta de apresentação em inglês, justificando porque você seria o/a candidato/a para esse posto (no máximo 350 palavras). É necessário ainda responder às perguntas do formulário de inscrição.  Agradecemos seu interesse por esta posição. Serão convidados/as para entrevistas somente os candidatos que atendam aos requisitos acima descritos.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.  About us  Insider One is the #1 platform  that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.   Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices . With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.  We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic . We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst , and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino’s, and the list goes on.  Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns  in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader  in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. The results speak for themselves.  From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities  in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.  Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers  that moves fast and agile, creating cutting‑edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.  What You Will Do   Develop our client base and execute processes to generate new sales opportunities.  Build relationships with our prospects by nurturing and educating them about our product and its value through outbound cold calls, emails, or even social media!  Personalize our content according to the prospect. We are building a human connection; our prospects should feel that they are valuable potential clients. Therefore, you should care about the details of them.  Pass on leads that are sales‑qualified to an account executive to close.  Understand client needs and requirements. You will also brainstorm together with your team on how we can identify key players and generate interest in Insider One’s products in targeted industries and segments.  Most importantly, you will learn—a LOT. You will join countless training sessions, and you will also learn from your team members and leaders who are top‑notch sales professionals.    What You Will Need   Good exposure to the e‑commerce space,  The ability to multitask and manage time effectively,  Excellent oral and written communication skills in Portuguese and English,  A strong phone presence and experience dialing dozens of calls per day,  Creativity in researching markets, identifying key players, and generating leads,  Flexibility to adapt quickly in a fast‑paced, start‑up environment,  Strong problem‑identification and objection‑resolution skills,  Preferably, digital marketing–related experience in a customer‑oriented position.    What We Offer   Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.  Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.  Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru.  Become a Shareowner through our eligibility‑based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build.  Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.  Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose‑driven social impact projects.  From global retreats to team‑building activities, expect year‑round events that turn into lifelong memories.    We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.  To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good‑hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.  If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.  We provide equal opportunity in a zero‑discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.  Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Die Schule wird von der Bundesrepublik Deutschland als Begegnungsschule gefördert und ist von der Ständigen Konferenz der Kultusminister (KMK) zur Abhaltung von Prüfungen der allgemeinen deutschen Hochschulreife (Abitur) ermächtigt. Mit zwei aufeinander abgestimmten Bildungsplänen sind sowohl deutsche als auch brasilianischen Abschlüsse anerkannt und möglich. Unsere freundlichen und sehr motivierten Schülerinnen und Schüler kennen und lernen in zwei Kulturkreisen und das bereits vom Kindergarten an. Auf diese Weise bekommen sie erweiterte Kenntnisse über Werte, Normen, Geschichte und Mentalität eines anderen Landes vermittelt.  Angeboten wird eine Stelle in Vollzeit. Neben der pädagogischen, erzieherischen Tätigkeit ist die Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in schulischen Gremien sowie Engagement bei außerunterrichtlichen Veranstaltungen ausdrücklich erwünscht.  Die Tätigkeit umfasst:    Arbeit in den Kindergartengruppen in deutscher Sprache  Teilnahme am Schulleben  aktive Beteiligung am Entwicklungsprozess des Kindergartens  Mitarbeit in der Unterrichts- und Schulentwicklung    Anforderungsprofil:   Gesucht werden engagierte Erzieher/ Erzieherinnen bzw. Kindheitspädagogen / Kindheitspädagoginnen, die Freude haben am pädagogischen Umgang mit Kindern von 2 bis 5 Jahren und über Sozialkompetenz, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und freundliches Auftreten verfügen. Erforderlich sind hohe Flexibilität, Aufgeschlossenheit, Motivation sowie Teamfähigkeit und ein starkes Interesse am kulturellen Umfeld (Brasilien/Südamerika). Die Beherrschung der Landessprache (Portugiesisch) ist keine Einstellungsvoraussetzung, jedoch wird das Erlernen dieser während des Arbeitsverhältnisses begrüßt und gefördert.   Arbeit in deutscher Sprache im Sinne eines konsequenten Immersionskonzeptes: Die Kinder erwerben die deutsche Sprache alltagsintegriert und authentisch durch sprachliches Vorbild, Interaktion und situatives Lernen. Daher ist Deutsch als Muttersprache der Erzieherin/ des Erziehers eine grundlegende Voraussetzung.  Ausbildung als ErzieherIn / KindheitspädagogIn  Arbeits- und Berufserfahrung wünschenswert  überdurchschnittliche Einsatzbereitschaft, Neugier und Arbeitsfreude,  Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit.    Sie erwartet ein hochinteressantes Arbeitsumfeld in einem motivierten, netten Team. Die Vergütung erfolgt nach der für die Schule gültigen Gehaltsrichtlinie und liegt im Landesvergleich weit über dem Durschnitt. Weitere Zusatzleistungen wie Krankenversicherung, Lebensversicherung, Mietzuschuss kommen hinzu. Bei Zuzug aus dem Ausland erhalten Sie eine Umzugspauschale sowie eine Flugkostenpauschale. Ihre vollständige Bewerbung mit Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Abschlüssen und Fortbildungsnachweisen richten Sie bitte per E-Mail an:  Thomas Duque Mand, Deutscher Schulleiter  Victoria Hesse, Leiterin Deutscher Kindergarten  Bitte verschaffen Sie sich gerne über die Videos einen ersten Eindruck von unserer Schule   Aktuelle Vorstellung Porto Seguro (2024, deutsche Untertitel)  Deutsches Curriculum an der Porto Seguro   #J-18808-Ljbffr

You make creative decisions based on evidence, not gut feeling  Commercially minded. You care about results, not just aesthetics  Fast‑moving. You can produce and iterate at pace without sacrificing quality  Proactive. You don’t wait to be told what to test next  Detail‑oriented. You spot what others miss  Clear communicator. You can brief creative teams effectively and articulate rationale    What We Offer   Fully remote with flexible hours (just maintain GMT overlap)  Competitive rate based on experience  Paid time off including UK bank holidays  Creative freedom to test bold ideas  Direct collaboration with founders and marketing team  Opportunity to shape the creative direction of a growing brand  Products that genuinely help people feel better    Important   This is a contractor position (not employment)  Applications welcome globally  Minimum 4‑hour daily overlap with UK hours required  CV must be submitted in English  Portfolio of ad creative work is required. Root Cause Analysis & Recommendation: Dive deep into quality data to uncover the underlying reasons for any quality shortfalls, discrepancies, or process inefficiencies observed in the BPO's work or the overall menu data. Translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for improvement.  Process Optimization & Governance: Work cross‑functionally with internal teams and the BPO vendor to propose and implement data‑backed process enhancements for menu quality. Team Support: Proactively monitor and provide feedback to up to 15 analysts.    Qualifications   3‑5 years of experience in operations and agent management roles with a strong focus on program management, process definition, ideally involving external partners or BPOs.  Proven experience in defining KPIs, setting performance thresholds, and developing quality frameworks.  Strong people skills with a proven ability to give feedback, build action plans based on data and leverage team performance.  Proficiency in data analysis tools, especially advanced Excel/Google Sheets functions (e.g., VLOOKUP, pivot tables, conditional formatting). Experience with SQL or other query languages is a significant plus.  Meticulous attention to detail and an unwavering commitment to data accuracy and integrity.  Excellent communication, negotiation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and manage relationships with external vendors and internal stakeholders. Trade Marketing Analyst plays a key role in driving brand visibility and commercial performance across Brazil markets. By analyzing sell‑in and sell‑out data, managing promotional activities, and collaborating with cross‑functional teams, the analyst contributes directly to the growth and positioning of Mattel's brands in retail environments.  What Your Impact Will Be   Planning and execution of Trade Marketing campaigns aligned with commercial and brand strategies, aiming to increase visibility and conversion at the point of sale (POS).  Development of promotional and visual communication materials for POS, including displays, giveaways, signage, and store branding.  Management of promotional actions and brand activations, such as events, product sampling, demonstrations, and seasonal campaigns, ensuring alignment with marketing and sales objectives.  Relationship management with commercial partners, clients, and internal teams, acting as a bridge between marketing, sales, and operations to ensure effective execution of initiatives.  Negotiation with suppliers and agencies for material production, service contracting, and promotional execution, focusing on cost optimization and quality.  Sell‑in and sell‑out data analysis, identifying opportunities, risks, and market trends to support strategic decision‑making and campaign adjustments.  Retail execution monitoring, including store visits, audits, and tracking of execution KPIs such as shelf share, out‑of‑stock rates, and brand visibility.  Budget control and management for Trade Marketing activities, including financial planning, expense tracking, and reporting.  Support to the sales team, providing materials, insights, and strategies to boost sales and strengthen brand presence across channels.  Involvement in all product categories, with a primary focus on POS and retail execution demands.  Participation in regional and global meetings, contributing local insights and aligning strategies with international stakeholders.  Availability for operational tasks, such as transporting materials, setting up displays, stocking stores, and supporting events when needed.  Collaboration with departments such as logistics, planning, and marketing, ensuring synergy and smooth execution of initiatives.    Qualifications   Bachelor's Degree in Marketing Technology  Bachelor's Degree in Advertising and Publicity  Previous experience (2–4 years) in Trade Marketing, Marketing, or Sales, preferably within consumer goods, retail, or toys/entertainment industries.  Experience collaborating across multifunctional teams (sales, marketing, operations).  Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and transform insights into actionable strategies.  Proficiency in budget management and performance tracking.  Knowledge of retail dynamics, shopper behavior, and trade marketing tools.  Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.  Strong communication and negotiation abilities, both written and verbal.  Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); experience with data visualization tools is a plus. description:

Minimum qualifications   Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.  5 years of experience creating and presenting customer-facing materials (e.g., pitches, narratives, or one-sheets) for sales teams.  5 years of experience in advertising sales, marketing, consulting, or media (e.g., search, social, mobile, display, and video media).  5 years of experience in consumer and market insights, media measurement, and privacy landscape.  Ability to communicate in English and Portuguese fluently to engage with local stakeholders. Understanding of the creator economy (e.g., IMAs, Social landscape) and how to leverage them for brand growth.  Ability to define local video strategy and create a solid framework for executive audiences.  Ability to translate creative ideas into business-generating initiatives. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.  In this role, you will build bold creative narratives that justify shifting budgets from TV and Social to YouTube. You will act as a \"Trusted Advisor\" to C-level stakeholders, translating complex brand needs into structured commercial packages for local and global clients.  Google\'s Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world\'s leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google\'s full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you\'ll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.  Responsibilities   Build creative and bold strategies that test the "TV-first legacy" of the Brazilian market.  Structure and productize creative solutions. This involves defining the best Influencer Marketing Agencies (IMAs) and orchestrating creator/package/brand content in alignment with the Brand Solutions team.  Translate rough client objectives into actionable brief sprints, specializing in concepting and ideation that aligns with local market trends.  Influence beyond media buyers, connecting with Creative and Planning leads at agencies to drive YouTube\'s growth and the adoption of Google’s creative trends and package solutions. This position will be based in our Office in Brazil in a full in‑person work model.  Position Summary  The digital workplace head is responsible for the strategy and management of digital workplace technologies and services, ensuring a seamless digital employee experience (DEX). This role covers all functions of the digital workplace, including the service desk management, budgeting, and IT asset management (hardware and software), enhancing digital dexterity, and driving positive business outcomes, while maintaining compliance with SOX and ITGC controls.  Main Responsibilities   Reporting to Infrastructure Head and partner with the CIO/CTO, human resources, facilities and other IT and business leaders to set the strategic direction of the digital workplace and DEX improvements.  Lead the digital workplace operations team focused on fulfilling (telephony included) end‑user support and service requests, including the IT service desk, the VIP and desktop support, A/V support, Active Directory, IT services catalogue and IT asset management (hardware & software) inventory.  Manage the annual budget for operating and capital expenditures and govern digital workplace technology usage, standards, and licensing to align with IT and company objectives while optimizing costs and enforcing data policies.  Contract administration including management of service level for services in the scope including licensing expiration, renewal with different services providers and procurement team.  Lead the development, publication and maintenance of the corporate IT catalogue of product and services and its roadmap aligned with business requirements and IT leaders.  Provide IT leaders and business with a consolidated overview of IT Service Support KPIs (support tickets and service requests) submitted by the business area, ensuring adherence to SLAs (Service Level Agreements).  Champion the modernization of workforce technology and services to enable new ways of working and digital transformation, while demonstrating digital dexterity and fostering a culture of workforce digital dexterity by leading adoption, enablement, and influence to achieve digital business goals.  Partner with HR to understand employees’ current challenges, new roles, demographic changes, mobility, hybrid work and more, incorporating this knowledge into digital workplace planning, while utilizing organizational change management best practices to drive technology adoption.  Partner with corporate real‑estate/facilities to create a smart workplace that supports hybrid and remote workers as much as onsite workers.  Collaborate with colleagues in internal communications to communicate how digital workplace applications benefit employees through enablement campaigns and measurement of customer satisfaction and eNPS.  Work with IT security and risk management to ensure that digital workplace technologies comply with corporate policies and industry standards.  Responsible for SOX and ITGC controls within the digital workplace, including the policies creation or update ensuring flawless execution and developing action plans for improvements when necessary.    Main Requirements   5+ years managing IT systems, processes and vendors.  5+ years of leading digital workplace team and processes including external service desk services  English mandatory  Experience with vendor governance, KPI Management, including demonstrated success in conducting RFPs and vendor service transitions.  Proven financial management skills with operational budget tasks.  Awareness of ways to measure Digital Experience and satisfaction.  Working knowledge of IT frameworks such as ITIL, including key processes – knowledge, incident, change, service request and major‑incident management.  Proven ability to manage rapidly changing business priorities, processes and technologies.  Experience managing a portfolio of digital workplace applications. title: Coordenador Social Media
description:
Nova oportunidade para Coordenador Social Media em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

O G4 nasce a partir de uma constatação simples e incômoda: crescer empresas no Brasil exige mais do que boas intenções e teoria. Exige método, repertório e decisões sustentadas por experiências reais.  Naquele momento, o ecossistema empresarial oferecia informação em excesso e direção de menos. Faltavam referências aplicáveis para quem precisava decidir sob pressão, estruturar crescimento e liderar empresas em ambientes complexos.  O G4 surge para ocupar esse espaço, com um foco claro: aproximar prática e método da realidade de quem constrói negócios no país.  Com o tempo, os desafios dos empresários evoluíram. As empresas cresceram, as decisões ganharam escala e as consequências se tornaram maiores. A atuação do G4 evoluiu junto, assim como a nossa marca, acompanhando a maturidade dos líderes e a complexidade dos negócios.  O que começa como uma iniciativa voltada à gestão se transforma, de forma consistente, em uma estrutura capaz de orientar decisões, sustentar crescimento e ampliar o impacto de quem faz o Brasil avançar.  Missão do Cargo  O Coordenador de Social Media será responsável por executar e coordenar as estratégias de mídia social definidas pelo Head de Social Media, garantindo a implementação eficiente das campanhas e o acompanhamento diário das atividades nas redes sociais. Este profissional deve ser especialista na operacionalização de estratégias digitais de Instagram, TikTok, Youtube, Spotify e Linkedin com foco na execução de alta qualidade, monitoramento de resultados e coordenação da equipe de criação e produção de conteúdo. É fundamental que tenha visão analítica e capacidade de traduzir insights em ações práticas para otimizar continuamente a performance das campanhas.  Responsabilidades e Atribuições  Executar e Coordenar Estratégias de Social Media:   Implementar as estratégias definidas pelo Head de Social Media, garantindo execução precisa e alinhada aos objetivos da empresa.  Coordenar a produção de conteúdo orgânico, assegurando consistência da marca e qualidade em todas as publicações.  Distribuir tarefas e acompanhar produtividade da equipe, desenvolvendo os profissionais.    Gerenciar Calendário Editorial e Produção de Conteúdo:   Desenvolver e manter calendários editoriais detalhados para todas as plataformas sociais.  Revisar e aprovar conteúdos antes da publicação, mantendo os padrões de qualidade e alinhamento com a estratégia de marca.    Monitorar performance e gerar relatórios   Acompanhar métricas diárias de desempenho dos conteúdos de todos os canais.  Preparar relatórios semanais e mensais com insights sobre performance, engajamento e alcance.  Identificar oportunidades de otimização e propor ajustes táticos nas campanhas.  Executar campanhas com influenciadores conforme diretrizes estratégicas estabelecidas.  Acompanhar entregáveis e performance das parcerias, garantindo cumprimento de contratos.  Supervisionar o atendimento e engajamento com a comunidade nas redes sociais.  Gerenciar crises menores e escalar situações complexas para o Head de Social Media.  Monitorar menções à marca e sentimento do público.    Requisitos e Qualificações  Competências Técnicas:  Coordenação de Projetos e Processos:   Experiência em gestão de Social Media e coordenação de equipes multidisciplinares.  Capacidade de criar e otimizar processos operacionais para maior eficiência.    Análise de Dados e Métricas:   Proficiência em ferramentas de analytics (Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Analytics, Google Analytics).  Capacidade de interpretar dados e transformá-los em insights acionáveis.  Experiência com ferramentas de social listening e monitoramento de marca.    Conhecimento de Plataformas Sociais:   Domínio operacional das principais plataformas (Instagram, Spotify, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube).  Compreensão de algoritmos e melhores práticas para cada plataforma.    Competências Comportamentais:  Gestão Operacional:   Habilidade para motivar e desenvolver profissionais júnior.  Exemplo: Conduzir reuniões diárias de alinhamento e acompanhar o desenvolvimento individual de cada membro da equipe.    Organização e Atenção aos Detalhes:   Excelente capacidade organizacional para gerenciar múltiplas campanhas e projetos.  Atenção aos detalhes para garantir qualidade e consistência nas entregas.    Comunicação Assertiva:   Habilidade para comunicar resultados, desafios e oportunidades de forma clara e objetiva.  Capacidade de fazer interface entre equipe operacional e liderança estratégica.    Adaptabilidade e Agilidade:   Flexibilidade para se adaptar rapidamente a mudanças de estratégia ou prioridades.  Capacidade de responder rapidamente a crises ou oportunidades emergentes.    Orientação para Resultados:   Foco constante no cumprimento de metas e KPIs estabelecidos.  Proatividade para identificar problemas e propor soluções antes que impactem os resultados.  Exemplo: Monitorar KPIs diariamente e implementar ajustes táticos para garantir cumprimento das metas mensais.    Formação e Experiência   Graduação em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade ou áreas relacionadas.  Sólida experiência em social media, preferencialmente em posições de coordenação.  Experiência prévia em empresas de educação, tecnologia ou growth marketing será um diferencial.    Informações Adicionais    Benefício flexível de R$ 1000,00 no cartão iFood Benefícios.    Saúde - Assistência Médica da Alice (sem coparticipação).   ️ Descanso Remunerado de 30 dias após 12 meses.  🤰 Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida.     ♀️ Bem Estar - Temos parceria com o Gympass, TotalPass, Apoio Psicológico através da plataforma Vittude e acesso ao Reservatório de Dopamina.    Educação - Acesso a plataforma dos conteúdos online do G4 e Imersões.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Product Designer Sênior
description:
Nova oportunidade para Product Designer Sênior em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação!  Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de Soluções para a Prática Médica,  para trabalhar de forma híbrida na cidade de São Paulo  .  Ao assumir o cargo de Product Designer SR na Afya, seu objetivo principal será garantir a experiência do usuário nos produtos, visando relacionar tanto os aspectos de usabilidade nas entregas, quanto aspectos de estratégia visando construir uma solução pautada sempre em feedbacks de usuários e em dados relevantes.  Você atuará na área de Product Design dentro da diretoria de Produto e fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar, relacionando-se no dia a dia com pessoas de times como Produto, tecnologia e Researcher.  ♿ Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.    Planejar e conduzir descobertas a fim de identificar e mapear oportunidades e dores relevantes dos nossos usuários e clientes, por meio de pesquisas e entrevistas com usuários;  Propor e participar da experimentação de hipóteses e conceitos, validando-os por meio de pesquisa com usuários, testes A/B, multivariáveis, split tests ou outros métodos de validação, a fim de ajudar na estratégia do produto;  Colaborar na definição de indicadores de sucesso e acompanhá-los por meio de follow ups recorrentes, para apoiar as decisões e direcionamentos do negócio;  Usar dados no desenvolvimento do projeto para formular hipóteses e sustentar decisões de Design;  Facilitar workshops e atividades de concepção junto ao time para guiar o desenvolvimento do produto, a fim de ter uma troca multidiscliplinar;  Executar e acompanhar processos de pesquisa com usuários, utilizando seus insights na construção e otimização do produto;  Construir e iterar experiências que estejam conectadas com objetivos de negócio e necessidades dos nossos usuários para alavancar a estratégia do produto;  Definir novos fluxos; criar interfaces usando nosso design system; criar protótipos de baixa, média e alta fidelidade quando preciso; realizando o handoff e acompanhamento da sua implementação.      O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):    Experiência sólida em UI Design, com cases que envolvam design systems, mockups, protótipos e microinterações.  Visão sistêmica de negócio e entendimento aprofundado de dores e necessidades dos usuários atreladas às necessidades de negócio;  Domínio de princípios e heurísticas de design, boas práticas de UX/UI e proficiência no Figma.  Experiência em product discovery e no desenvolvimento de produtos digitais em ambientes web e mobile.  Conhecimento de métricas de produto e KPIs, sabendo como usá-los para orientar decisões de design.    Informações adicionais  ❤️ GENTE É O MELHOR DA GENTE, por isso, oferecemos benefícios e parcerias para o nosso time.   Confira os principais abaixo:     Para o dia a dia:    Vale-alimentação / refeição;  Flexibilidade de horários e alocações (para vagas Remotas);  Vale-transporte (para vagas Hibridas ou Presenciais);      UP na remuneração:    Multibenefícios: Benefício flexível via Cartão Flash para usar como preferir.  Gympass / Wellhub;  Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;  Licença parental estendida (até 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais);  Rede D'Ór: suporte e informações importantes para a saúde da mamãe e do bebê com uma rede credenciada de enfermeiros;  Parceria com o SESC da sua região (programação variada nas áreas de educação, saúde, cultura, lazer e assistência);  Day Off de Aniversário (um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário).      Desenvolvimento e Aprendizado:    Plataforma com diversos cursos para aprimorar seu conhecimento (UCA);  Programa de desenvolvimento para líderes;  Mentoria para Mulheres da Afya (MMA);  Desconto em cursos de graduação e pós-graduação nas unidades de ensino da Afya.    ✍️ Diferencial para Professor Médico:   O MAIOR ECOSSISTEMA DE EDUCAÇÃO E SOLUÇÕES PARA PRÁTICA MÉDICA DO BRASIL.  A marca Afya nasceu em 2019, mas nossa história começou muito antes. Surgimos da união entre a NRE Educacional, maior grupo de faculdades de Medicina do país, fundado em 1999, com a MEDCEL, marca de cursos preparatórios para prova de residência médica.  Com o nosso crescimento acelerado, adquirimos nos últimos anos novas unidades de ensino — já são mais de 30 espalhadas pelo Brasil — e mais de 10 startups que oferecem soluções digitais para a prática médica — Afya Whitebook, Afya iClinic, Afya Papers, Glic e Cliquefarma são algumas marcas do nosso portfólio. Acesse afya.com.br para conhecer mais sobre a nossa história e todas as soluções que oferecemos.  A Afya é uma companhia de capital aberto desde 2019, com ações negociadas na bolsa de valores Nasdaq, nos Estados Unidos. Em 2023 disponibilizamos nossas ações também na bolsa brasileira, a B3. Saiba mais sobre esse assunto em ir.afya.com.br .  Nosso propósito é transformar a saúde em conjunto com quem tem a medicina como vocação.  Para isso, contamos com um time de 10 mil pessoas curiosas, parceiras, comprometidas, adaptáveis e realizadoras. Gente de todos os cantos do Brasil, com diferentes sotaques, mas falando a mesma língua, unida pelo mesmo propósito. Se você se identifica com o jeito Afya de ser, vem com a gente transformar a saúde com educação e tecnologia . #VemSerAfya   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Shipboard Medispa Physician
description:
Confira a vaga para Shipboard Medispa Physician em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

This position is based on a Cruise Ship  Education and Experience Requirements   Completed medical education and hold a medical degree from a recognized college or university.  Hold a current valid medical license.  Board certification or similar international certification in Plastic Surgery or Dermatology preferred but not required.  Comfortable with giving presentations/speaking in front of large groups.  Fluency in English.  Strong interpersonal skills.    Reports to: Spa Manager  Job Summary  The Medi‑Spa Physician administers cosmetic medical procedures to onboard guests. They must possess the clinical knowledge to administer these procedures safely and effectively, and be able to explain accurately all aspects of the products and services to the guests. They must have excellent communication skills and be able to provide aesthetic medical solutions, safely and effectively, to address the concerns of on board guests. The Medi‑Spa Physician will work with the Medi‑Spa Sales Consultant, who will assist them with the sales, marketing, and promotional aspects of the position. The Medi‑Spa Sales Consultant will also translate for the Medi‑Spa Physician if necessary. The Medi‑Spa Physician will review and give final approval for all service/treatment plans organized and booked by the Medi‑Spa Sales Consultant. Position requirements: possess the ability to work without direct supervision and actively promote the services to the guests, work closely with the Medi‑Spa Sales Consultant, must have enthusiasm and possess excellent customer service skills, be able to give an effective presentation as it relates to medi‑spa services, enjoy working with people and possess a friendly and outgoing personality, excellent communication and listening skills, basic computer knowledge, and be a team player.  Responsibilities   Be on time for work, prompt for each appointment.  Provide consistent professional medi‑spa services and treatments in accordance with OneSpaWorld’s medi‑spa protocols.  Conduct patient follow‑up as required.  Be flexible with scheduling, supporting the needs of the spa and guest.  Properly care for equipment and use proper amounts of product/supplies to assist with cost control.  Follow service pricing policy set by OneSpaWorld.  Prior to all services, complete with the guest the Medical Record which must be stored at the completion of each cruise in the Spa Manager’s office or designated place within the spa facilities for a period of 2 years (3 years on Cunard and P&O).  Cross‑promote other spa services.  Uphold the standards of sanitation and sterilization as directed by ship and company policy and procedure.  Properly clean and restock medi‑spa treatment room as required.  Manage medical product and supply inventory.  Communicate to management any and all occurrences involving staff or guests in the spa that require attention.  Handle guests’ questions and concerns professionally and courteously.  Provide accurate, appropriate and immediate responses to all requests by guests.  Maintain a positive attitude and contribute toward a quality work environment.  Regularly attend, participate in and support training and staff meetings for the spa.  Required team meetings: embarkation day meetings and sea day team meetings.  Assist in all areas of spa operation as requested by management.  Train new spa staff in medi‑spa services/cross‑promotion skills – follow up must be carried out to ensure staff are confident with services and promotions.  Follow Medi‑Spa Operations Policies.  Email report daily and inventory report with every end of cruise report.  For all guests, doctors must review the guest consultation information with them prior to the service.  All guests receiving treatments (including complimentary treatments) must complete the required consent forms; doctors are required to complete a medical record for each guest.  At conclusion of the treatment, review Aftercare Instructions with the guest and provide them with a copy; conclude by thanking the guest for the opportunity to take care of them. Schedule a follow‑up appointment and assist them with scheduling at the front desk.  Clean your room and set up for your next guest.  Do not stand around the front desk between services. Treatment room should look the same at the start and end of every day and between each guest.  End of Day Checklist:  Dispose of open unused needles  Dispose of Bio‑Hazard bag if full  Take Sharps Container to Medical facility if full  Sterilize table and countertops  Fill out inventory control form  Lock product storage cabinets  Lock treatment room  Email daily revenue report to shore side team       General Guidelines  A clean, non‑intimidating, state‑of‑the‑art and stress‑free environment is not only what we strive to offer our guests, it is the goal for our staff as well. Following are some policies that we have put in place to help us avoid unnecessary contention.   Medi‑Spa Physicians may only be booked for services for which they are qualified to administer.  In some cases, it is impossible to fairly book services you are not qualified to perform all services.  Medi‑Spa Physicians are not allowed to refuse or trade services that they are certified to perform. Guest requests cannot be moved or changed without the Spa Manager’s approval.  All staff members are required to perform general duties during their scheduled hours, as directed by the manager onboard. General duties may include, but are not limited to, promotional duties, port cleaning, staff meetings, training and stock inventory.    Guidelines for Protection and Sanitization (GPS)   Be familiar with OneSpaWorld’s ‘GPS’ to safety.  Understand and practice the required self‑screening procedures.  Understand and follow the agreed upon procedures for symptomatic guests or employees.  Understand and adhere to staff and guest Physical Distancing Policy.  Understand and adhere to Staff Personal Hygiene Policy.  Understand and adhere to the Hand Washing Policy.  Arrive at the spa between five and ten minutes prior to assigned shift start time.  Understand proper use and disposal of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for the modality and for handling soiled linen, waste, and chemicals.  Be familiar with the approved disinfecting products available at the spa location including proper use, contact time, disinfection methods and proper storage and handling procedures.  Understand and adhere to the Treatment Room Preparation requirements.  Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable modality and services performed.  Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable spa area.  Understand the Sanitation Log Policy and complete logs as required.  Understand and adhere to the Retail Product Handling and Transferring Procedure.  Understand and adhere to the Product Sampling Procedure.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

Join to apply for the Grupo QuintoAndar | Senior Data Engineer  role at QuintoAndar   About Grupo QuintoAndar  We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.  Hiring Process Stages   Application  Interview with Recruiter  Tech Screening  Technical Interviews with Data Team  Offer    About the Role  We are looking for a skilled and motivated Data Engineer Specialist to join our team. The responsibilities of this role is to design, build, and maintain a robust, self-service, scalable, and secure data platform and end-to-end data pipelines that empowers Data Analysts, and Data Scientists to deliver insights and drive strategic decision-making.  Responsibilities of a Data Engineer at QuintoAndar   Build and maintain a high-performance data platform that meets the company's needs, connects with product solutions, and leads analytical innovation, enabling incredible architectures and efficient platforms;  Create and edit data pipelines, considering business logic that best applies to the area in question, choosing levels of aggregation, grouping and transforming fields, checking data quality, and cleaning the data;  Create data modeling and transformation workflows, enabling the creation of clear and accessible data abstractions;  Responsible for the entire code development lifecycle (monitoring deployment, documentation, performance, security, adding metrics and alarms, ensuring SLO budget compliance, and more);  Investigate inconsistencies and be able to trace the source of differences (data troubleshooting);  Enable teams across the company to access and use data more effectively through self-service tools and well-modeled datasets;  Align with stakeholders to understand their primary needs, while also having a holistic view of the problem and proposing extensible, scalable, and incremental solutions;  Conduct PoCs and benchmarks to determine the best tool for a given problem, and decide whether to use an off‑the‑shelf solution or develop one in‑house;  Contribute to defining the strategic vision, crossing team and service boundaries to solve problems;  Advocate for the value of data analytics and engineering within the organization and fostering a data‑driven culture;  Be a reference within the chapter on technical concepts, tools, and/or best coding practices.    What we are looking for   Has 7 or more years of experience in Data Engineering roles;  Specialist in technologies, solutions, and concepts of Big Data (Spark, Hadoop, Hive, MapReduce) and multiple languages (YAML, Python);  Experience with Airflow, Spark, AWS and Databricks;  Strong foundation in software engineering principles, with experience working on data‑centric systems;  Experience with columnar storage solutions and/or data lakehouse concepts;  Proficiency in Python, or one of the main programming languages, and a passion for writing clean and maintainable code.  Strong knowledge in optimizing SQL query performance;  Experience in building multidimensional data models (Star and/or Snowflake schema);  Understanding of the data lifecycle and concepts such as lineage, governance, privacy, retention, anonymization, etc.;  Knowledge in infrastructure areas such as containers and orchestration (Kubernetes, ECS), CI/CD strategies, infrastructure as code (Terraform), observability (Prometheus, Grafana), among others;  Proficiency in English - our code, documentation, tools, and materials are often structured in English.  Excellent communication skills, proactively sharing and collaborating with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable data solutions;  Experience as a tech/project lead or similar;  Curiosity, detail‑orientation, and thrive in a fast‑paced, data‑driven environment.    You will stand out if   You have participated in building large‑scale data platforms for big data sets and teams using Big Data technologies such as Spark, Trino, Hive, Atlas, Ranger, etc.  Experience in building semantic layers.
